name: @local/dsh-live-tps
description: Live token throughput (tok/s) for the dsh web composer stats row — an always-visible pill placed inline after the average tok/s pill (keeps the last reading through tool phases/steps, dimming when idle) (3s time-anchored window, 200ms ticks, EMA-smoothed, per-bucket chars/token calibration over the newest 3 settled steps (model-switch adaptive), plus a settled-step measured-rate fallback and the host-side sessionStats projection as a view-independent source so short steps, character-less providers and the first steps after a model switch still report a rate).
